sources: https://ollama.com/search?c=cloud  (per-model pricing, usage class, context, badge rows)
lib/cost.mjs PRICES  (USD/1M: input, cached-input, output — price source of truth)
notes: Cloud catalog only (oLLaMa Cloud subscription models; no local/downloadable tags).
No image GENERATION models on cloud (local macOS experimental only; future: Cloudflare Workers AI flux-schnell).
qwen3-vl is NOT on cloud (downloadable /library tags only).
Pricing key in cost.mjs is the single source of truth; modeldb never duplicates numbers.
usage classes are ollama.com's own tiers (Low/Medium/High/Extra High) = demand, not quality.

beam.free: with paid plan or usage credits (no per-token price published)
facts: Sparse MoE: 501B total, 23B active, 256 experts, 1M context.
Vendor claims token-efficient reasoning: ~3x fewer reasoning tokens than a typical thinking model.
Benchmark profile: SWE-Bench Verified 81.6, Terminal Bench 80.1 (from model card).
Smoke-tested live 2026-10-25 on the OpenAI-compat path: text OK, tool_calls shape OK, 19.8K-token needle retrieved in 1.6s.
Image input cleanly rejected with HTTP 400 'this model does not support image input'.
Reasoning tokens count against any max_tokens cap — never set a low output cap.
useFor: Heavy build/main-lane coding and agentic work at zero token cost
Very long context sweeps (needle-finding across tens of thousands of tokens verified fast)
Sessions where minimizing wall-time-per-token AND dollar cost both matter
avoidFor: long creative writing (it is a builder, not a prose model)

facts: Z.ai flagship for the era of long-horizon tasks.
Proven default main-lane model in this setup since mid-2026.
'Most capable open-weights model for coding', major gains on long-horizon agentic tasks.
Same pricing class as glm-5.2; pick by latest-or-proven preference.
Z.ai's first natively multimodal model; ~18B active parameters.
Vendor places it near Claude Opus 4.8 on coding and agentic benchmarks.
Cheapest thinking+vision+1M-context combo on the cloud index.
avoidFor: nothing serious — it is the utility knife of this catalog

facts: Only general-purpose vision+tools chat model on cloud at review time.
Image understanding live-verified: 1px red PNG via OpenAI-compat data-URL answered 'Red'.
Family page: frontier-level performance at each size; audio badge is family-wide, verify per tag before relying on it.
Next-gen Flash: 'generational leap in agentic tasks, coding, Computer Use and cybersecurity'.
~3x faster online inference, -70% cost vs minimax-m3.
avoidFor: no known hard negatatives; 976K ctx cap is the main limit

facts: Coding and agentic frontier of the M3 line; largely superseded by cheaper m3.1-flash.
useFor: when M3-class quality is required and m3.1 feels weak
avoidFor: budget work — m3.1-flash is same-class for far less

facts: M2-series coder/agent; smallest context window of the M-line (192K).
useFor: tight multimodal-free coding loops on older M2 behavior
avoidFor: modern agentic work (m3.1-flash dominates at same price class)

facts: Legacy M2 original; no price row on the current cloud index; superseded by m2.7 and m3.
useFor: behavioral repro of old M2 runs

facts: Natively multimodal flagship, built for coding and agentic work.
Excels at long-horizon tasks, complex software engineering, multi-step reasoning.
'Most capable model to date' of the Kimi line; native multimodal agentic.
Most expensive model on the cloud index.
useFor: hardest long-horizon multimodal agent tasks when budget is secondary
avoidFor: routine work — Small tasks waste the price point

facts: Coding-specialized agentic descendant of K2.6; vision-capable per live /api/tags (2026-10-25).
useFor: kimi-line behavior with tighter budget than k3

facts: Native multimodal agentic model: long-horizon coding, coding-driven design, proactive autonomous execution, swarm-based task orchestration.
Greater capability, faster inference, higher throughput, scales to larger models.
Listed price is 'From $0.30/$1.20' — variant-based; the :1017 variant may price differently.
avoidFor: relying on exact variant pricing without checking `babyzilla cost` output

facts: Newest deepseek flash build (2026-10-17).
useFor: same as base; prefer when freshness matters

facts: Frontier MoE with large context and three reasoning modes.
DeepSeek's strongest reasoning class at roughly 1/4 of kimi-k3's output price.
useFor: frontier text reasoning below kimi prices

facts: Newest Mistral large flagship; multimodal.
avoidFor: cheaper peers exist for most lanes

facts: General-purpose multimodal MoE; NO thinking capability (no thinking badge on cloud index or tags API).
High-throughput reasoning for long-running agent workflows.
Pricing profile: very cheap input ($0.10), pricey output ($3.00).
useFor: long-input, short-output agent loops (feed lots of context, tools emit little)

facts: Absolute cheapest input tokens with thinking: $0.015/$0.60.
256K context.
useFor: distillation on a budget (read much, write short)

facts: Cheapest output tokens that still carry tools+thinking ($0.06/$0.24).
OpenAI's open-weight reasoning MoE (Apache-2.0), Aug 2025 vintage.
NOT on the current cloud price index (availability/pricing unclear 2026-10-25) — cost.mjs still carries $0.15/$0.60 historical pricing.
Library pages remain live. Treat as historic fallback, verify before relying on it.
avoidFor: production lanes until presence on cloud index re-verified

facts: Small sibling of gpt-oss:120b; same cloud-index caveat as the 120b (not on current price index).
Specialized: turns a state + a schema of typed questions into decisions (guided-choice flows).
Non-autoregressive single-pass architecture — not a chat generalist.
Served via the /v1/systemone API shape, not standard chat.
Max 4 images per request, 4 MiB / 16 MP each; billed per INPUT token (cost.mjs: $0.24 in, no output token billing).
Capabilities on /api/tags are literally [decision, vision] — no tools/thinking.
useFor: structured decision answer flows built on the systemone API
avoidFor: anything needing >4 images/request or >64K input tokens
